module purpose: neorv32_cpu_lsu captures the access address (mar) and a misalignment flag when ctrl_i.lsu_mo_we is set, registers a data-bus request (store data replicated to the access size, byte enables, rw/priv/debug/amo attributes, a decoded atomic code and a lock flag), issues the request strobe only for an aligned request without a PMP fault, tracks a pending access until acknowledge or trap, and returns aligned, sign- or zero-extended load data on rdata_o with wait status on wait_o and load/store misaligned and access-fault bits on err_o.

use-case flows.value: a load/store request: ctrl_i.lsu_req taken into pending when no access is outstanding, cleared on bus acknowledge or ctrl_i.cpu_trap, and the bus strobe issued only for an aligned request without a PMP fault
access address captured from addr_i into mar under ctrl_i.lsu_mo_we and driven to the bus address and to mar_o
misalignment decision from addr_i(1 downto 0) and the access size ctrl_i.ir_funct3(1 downto 0)
request registered under ctrl_i.lsu_mo_we: write data replicated to the access size, byte enables decoded from addr_i, rw/priv/debug/amo attributes and the decoded atomic code
atomic operation code decoded from ctrl_i.ir_funct12(11 downto 7)
lock flag set for an atomic request with ctrl_i.ir_funct12(8) = '0' and cleared when no access is pending
bus read data selected by mar(1 downto 0), sign- or zero-extended by ctrl_i.ir_funct3 and registered on rdata_o while pending, zero otherwise
err_o load/store misaligned and access-fault bits (bus error or registered PMP fault) qualified by pending and ctrl_i.lsu_rw, and wait_o as the inverted bus acknowledge
mar, misaligned, the registered request fields, the lock flag, rdata_o, pmp_err and pending cleared while rstn_i = '0'
